# LinkIconButton

Link icon button: an icon that navigates. It renders an anchor with an accessible `label`, and has no disabled or loading state.

**Import:** `import { LinkIconButton } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkIconButton/LinkIconButton.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkIconButton/LinkIconButton.stories.jsx` — Overview, Appearances, Spacing, Selected, HoveredState, PressedState, KeyboardFocus, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkIconButton/LinkIconButton.mdx`

## Usage

Use a link icon button when an icon alone opens another page or site and space is limited, such as the Help Center link in the top bar. For an icon that acts on the current page, use Icon button. For a link with a label, use Link button.

## Best practices

### Keep space between link icon buttons. {#keep-space-between-link-icon-buttons}

Leave a gap so neighboring link icon buttons read as separate targets.

Do: A clear gap between link icon buttons.
Don't: Link icon buttons touching.

### Say where the link goes. {#say-where-the-link-goes}

The `label` is the accessible name and the tooltip. Name the destination:
"Open Help Center", not "Link" or a bare "Help". The label is never drawn, so
the difference shows only on hover, on focus and to a screen reader.

```jsx
// Incorrect: says nothing about the destination.
<LinkIconButton href="/help" icon="circle-question" label="Link" />

// Correct.
<LinkIconButton href="/help" icon="circle-question" label="Open Help Center" />
```

### Keep it square. {#keep-it-square}

Link icon buttons stay 32 or 24 square, and round only in top navigation
(`shape="circle"`). Link icon button has no prop to fill its container; never
stretch one to fill a row.

### A link goes somewhere; a button does something. {#a-link-goes-somewhere-a-button-does-something}

If the icon acts on the current page, use Icon button. Navigation uses a link icon button so assistive technology announces a link and it can be opened in a new tab.

### Pick a glyph people know. {#pick-a-glyph-people-know}

Use the glyph people already read as that destination.

Do: A question mark reads as help.
Don't: A star does not read as the Help Center.

### Give each destination its own glyph. {#give-each-destination-its-own-glyph}

Do not reuse one glyph for several links in the same area.

Do: Help Center and settings each have their own glyph.
Don't: One link glyph for two destinations.

## Accessibility

- `label` is required and says where the link goes. A missing label fails `check:icon-button-name`.
- It has no disabled state. Disabled links leave the tab order and do not say why; use validation and error messages instead.
- `target="_blank"` adds `rel="noopener noreferrer"`; say so in the label if it opens a new tab.
- The focus ring is 2px in `--ds-border-focused`. Never remove it.

## Related

- To act with an icon, use Icon button.
- To navigate with a label, use Link button.

## Parts

1. **Container.** An anchor drawn as a square button: 32 at default spacing and 24 at compact. `shape="circle"` rounds it.
2. **Icon.** A Font Awesome Free glyph at 16.
3. **Label.** Not drawn. It is the accessible name and the tooltip, and says where the link goes.

### Appearance

| Appearance | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Most link icon buttons: a destination with a clear, familiar glyph. Example: Open Help Center. |
| Subtle | Links in toolbars, table rows and headers where it is already clear they are interactive. |
| Primary | The main way forward from a small area when space allows no label. Use sparingly. |
| Discovery | The way into a new experience. |

### Spacing

Default spacing suits most places. Use compact in table rows and inline toolbars.

### States

Hover, pressed and focus are the browser's own. A link icon button has no disabled or loading state.

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Hovered | The container takes the appearance's hovered fill. |
| Pressed | The container takes the appearance's pressed fill. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the edge, for keyboard focus only. |
| Selected | The selected role fill and icon, with `aria-current`. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Fill: default, subtle | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle`, hovered and pressed steps. Default adds a 1px `--ds-border-input` edge. |
| Fill: primary, discovery | `--ds-background-brand-bold`, `--ds-background-discovery-bold`, each with hovered and pressed steps. |
| Fill: selected | `--ds-background-selected` with hovered and pressed steps. |
| Icon | `--ds-icon-subtle` (default, subtle), `--ds-icon-inverse` (primary, discovery); the selected role. 16, `--icon-md`. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |
| Size | 32: `--item-height-md`. 24: `--item-height-sm`. Square. |
| Radius | 6: `--button-radius-default`. Compact 4: `--button-radius-compact`. Circle 50%. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Say where the link goes: "Open Help Center". | A bare "Help", or "Link". |
| Use sentence case. | Title case. |
